summary: OpenAI launched a Health feature in ChatGPT that lets eligible U.S. users connect medical records and Apple Health to get personalized health insights.

categories.reason: A consumer AI product now integrates personal medical records and health data for personalized insights, touching the digital health data workflow, though no clinical or underwriting use is stated.
categories.quote: Health in ChatGPT now lets eligible U.S. users securely connect medical records and Apple Health to get more personalized insights and better understand their health.
